rotation-invariant loss: pipeline diagnostic, its returned R is arbitrary

blind_candidates.json.selection: lowest valid blind optimisation loss; numerical tie (relative 1e-9) broken by the blind VALIDATION-cache loss (split-safe only); never by MCC
blind_candidates.json.reference_loss_tolerance: tau = 0.01 x (95th percentile - minimum) of the Haar start losses of the same search (landscape scale), used only after locking to compare L(R_hat) with L(R*)

post_hoc_shortlist.added: after W2-04 evaluation (development, chosen with truth-referenced sweep flags; not part of the frozen W2-01 registry)

ids.surface: E-RBF block D1 teacher, S-min (validation loss) - refitted deterministically, state saved

S0.refine: Givens coordinate descent, 13-point grid over [-span, span] + 8-step golden section per plane; spans 45, 15, 5, 1.5, 0.5 degrees (shrink after a sweep with relative improvement < 1e-9); max 30 sweeps / 60000 evaluations per refinement

S1.trigger (blind diagnostics only): an E01/E02 BS-B cell whose selected R is not converged, or has near-minima (within 1e-3 relative loss) separated by > 0.05, or whose selected rotations across the 3 x 3 integration x search seeds of the same toy / variant / metric are not all within 0.05 of each other

independent_D_cache.pool: TRAIN subjects not used by any of the three medium caches
